note: Large family camping resort on the south shore of Buffalo Lake near Stettler: a sandy public beach, mini-golf, farm animals, a steam train, movie nights and summer event weekends, plus an annual music festival the weekend after the September long weekend. Most sites are among trees. Generators only at set hours. --Claude
summary: Read the operator's rates (2026), amenities and map pages: base corrected C$48 -> C$36 (unserviced, farthest from the beach; C$48 was the cheapest power+water), high C$65 confirmed; water/sewer hookups, showers, laundry, store, dump, potable taps, wifi; booking by phone only (fcfs 'never' cleared - nothing states it); derived ~200 site count cleared. Google 4.1 from 1,609. Pin is the gate on the township road, ~280 m south of the sites' centre.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): base C$36 (unserviced, farthest from the beach) - power and water from C$48, full service C$50 (400s) to C$65; all under C$69. No gateway within 40 km (Edmonton 129 km).

PRESENCE: http://www.olmacdonalds.com/ and rates.html answered 200 (rates page Last-Modified 2026-06-27, home page 'NOW TAKING RESERVATIONS FOR THE 2026 & 2027 SEASON'), phone 403-742-6603. Google Maps 4.1 from 1,609 reviews, phone +1 403-742-6603. RV Life stored 4 stars, $$. Passes.
PHONE (stored empty): recommend 403-742-6603 (site, map brochure and Google agree).

LONG STAY: every site type is priced by the day on the rates page, reservations by phone; the map labels one small 'SEASONAL LOOP' near the registration office and the operator markets no seasonal or monthly rates. Test 1 pass (nights sold), test 2 pass (nightly rates posted, no standing minimum - group sites only need 3 nights on long weekends), test 3/4 pass (seasonal share looks small: one labelled loop among ~400 numbered sites), test 5 pass. No occupancy check possible (no online engine). Keep.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - keep; lakeview lead): the operator advertises 'beach front campsites' and 'POWER & WATER At the Beach $60.00'. On imagery the resort's own sandy swim beach (day use: 'Visitors & Day Use Adults $3.00', 'Public Beach ... No boats in swim area') is ~250 m wide and the nearest units at its edge sit ~70-90 m from the water across that open sand; elsewhere the shore is a wide marsh/reed fringe. The day-use beach rules out on-water. The beach-edge sites look across open sand to the lake, so lakeview is possible for them, but the site numbers can't be placed on imagery (the map is schematic) - left as a lead, no change.

PIN (52.43400,-112.94530): on Township Road 40-2 at the gate, south of the resort; the sites span about 52.4345-52.4395. Recommend 52.4365,-112.9460 (near the registration office, the middle of the site areas), ~280 m north.
SEASON: no campground dates are published (map: candy store hours 'July, August - May & June hours will be posted'); left unset.
